retraction.reason: Review A15 (8) found that the item’s English sitelink "Eritrean Civil Wars" redirects to "Eritrean War of Independence" (Q607257), a different item this atlas already holds as its own record, and that article names the Eritrean Civil Wars only in its See also list, and no section is about them. So there is no article and no section to read a span from, the quoted summary was the War of Independence’s lead and not this record’s, and the record carries no edge to anything. Section 1 of the brief says that a record which cannot earn an edge is retracted with its reason, and that is what this is.

title: Eritrean Civil Wars
summary: Wikidata item Q2139988, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1972–1974 and 1980–1981 conflicts in Eritrea". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
